title: sedum album subsp. clusianum
intro: Sedum album subsp. clusianum, commonly known as White Stonecrop or White Sedum, is a perennial succulent plant in the family Crassulaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum album subsp. clusianum include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
